header.trialActiveBanner: Trial active until {{date}}. Guests can play and redeem fully. Subscribe before it ends so this venue stays live in the app.
header.trialExpiredBanner: Trial ended — this venue is locked for guests (hidden from map, no games/offers/check-in). Subscribe to unlock.
header.staffLeadBeforeLink: Staff view — verify redemptions and acknowledgments. Open
header.managerLead: Manager — analytics, campaigns, receipts, and redemptions. Team invites are owner-only.
header.ownerLead: Owner — includes staff invitations and subscription links when your org has a billing portal URL.
header.billingCanceledSupport: · contact support to restore organization billing
header.billingPortalMissing: Billing portal URL not configured — contact support to connect Stripe customer portal.
header.commercialClarityBody: the organization subscription covers partner portal access and venue features. In-app guest subscriptions and optional play-time top-ups are billed by the app stores to the Cafe Social product account (not shared with venues unless separately contracted). Your contract defines venue fees; this portal shows Stripe org status only.

playbook.title: Partner playbook
playbook.lead: Go live checklist, vocabulary, and staff training for this venue.
playbook.step1Body: You set this during onboarding. Adjust under Locations & content if your floor plan changes.
playbook.step2AfterDeepLink: on a phone with the app installed.
playbook.step3BeforeLinks: Publish a perk, a challenge, and an offer under
playbook.step3AfterLinks: (challenge perk → wallet code; MEMBER_CARD offer → guest claims then shows member card; AUTO offer e.g. 2× XP applies while playing).
playbook.step4Body: use the partner brief wording for table tents; point guests to the app + your venue context.
playbook.step5Body: Perk code = wallet reward (scan code / mark redeemed). Member card = guest identity + pending offers + check-in. Managers can void with reason.
playbook.orderNudgeHint: Order-nudge push copy is driven by venue type templates in the CMS when set; otherwise platform defaults apply.
playbook.glossaryChallenges: Challenges — goals guests complete (play games, check in). May grant a perk.
playbook.glossaryPerks: Perks — staff-honoured rewards in the guest wallet (code/QR). From challenges, tiers, or codes.
playbook.glossaryOffers: Offers — venue promos. AUTO (e.g. 2× XP, no claim) or MEMBER_CARD (claim, then staff honours via member card).
playbook.glossaryPlatform: Platform rewards — Cafe Social daily/weekly quests and XP tiers (not venue-owned).
playbook.staffPerkCode: Perk code / QR — guest earned a wallet reward. Scan the code or mark redeemed on the list.
playbook.staffMemberCard: Member card — who the guest is. Records visit/check-in, shows pending MEMBER_CARD offers to honour, and stamps MANUAL challenges.
playbook.trialBody: While your trial is active, guests can play and redeem fully. When the trial ends without a subscription, this venue is locked and disappears from the guest app (no map, detect, games, or offers).

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.rangeHint: Custom from/to overrides the rolling window when both are set (UTC dates).
analytics.repeatVisitorsHint: ≥2 days at this venue · {{percent}}% of visitors
analytics.geofenceLead: Approximate dwell from OS geofence events. Pairs each player's enter→exit; open enters at period end are listed separately. Compare with calendar visit rows (presence proxy) for context.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.trustSafetyBody: Player reports, venue bans, and ban appeals stay in this portal — bans block play and redemptions here only. Use dismiss when no action is needed; audit log below captures staff actions for accountability.
moderation.lead: Open player reports and venue bans. Banning blocks play and redemptions at this location. Dismiss clears a report without banning.
moderation.dismissalNoteLabel: Note to reporter (optional, shown in app)
moderation.appealsLead: Players who are venue-banned can submit one open appeal per location. Resolve with an outcome, optional internal note, and an optional message to the player (if you notify them).
moderation.viewActiveBan: View active ban for this player
moderation.noteTemplateResolvedInformally: Spoke with parties on site; resolved informally.
moderation.playerMessageLabel: Message to player (optional; used if you notify)

campaigns.title: Marketing campaigns
campaigns.lead: Push to players who visited this venue in the last N UTC days. Only sends to accounts with partner marketing on and not in total privacy (server-side).
campaigns.orderNudgeLead: Order nudge (after dwell) uses optional per-venue overrides in the CMS, else templates matched to this venue's venue types (super admin), else platform defaults.

bindings.lead: Metadata links for this campaign (challenges, perks, offers at this venue). No automation runs on these yet.

receipts.title: Receipt submissions
receipts.lead: 90-day retention target per submission. Approve or reject from detail view.

redemptions.title: Perk redemptions
redemptions.lead: Each redemption shows a staff verification code — match it before honouring the perk. Managers and owners can void with a reason (row greys out; exports and analytics reflect voids). This gives a simple fraud-resistant audit trail without spreadsheets.
